opening.argument: The material identifies an independent group of Southern Appalachian residents and activists opposing mountaintop-removal coal mining, while campaign messaging demands that UBS change its policy and stop funding companies engaged in that practice. Demonstrators holding “HANDS OFF APPALACHIA” and “UBS” signs, alongside the campaign’s “JOIN US!” invitation, are recognizable forms of public protest and civic participation. The invitation does not require payment, investment, credential submission, or account access, and it is not presented as a deceptive transaction or promise of financial return.

citations.quote: We are an independent group of Southern Appalachian residents & activists opposing the practice of mountaintop removal coal mining
demanding UBS change their official policy
